text_en: If the offering is a sacrifice of well-being, if you offer an animal of the herd, whether male or female, you shall offer one without blemish before the Lord .
text_cn: 若有人奉献和平祭，如所献的是牛，应在上主面前献一头无瑕的公牛或母牛，

text_en: You shall lay your hand on the head of the offering and slaughter it at the entrance of the tent of meeting; and Aaron’s sons the priests shall dash the blood against all sides of the altar.
text_cn: 先按手在牺牲头上，后在会幕门口宰了；亚郎的儿子司祭们，将血洒在祭坛四周。

text_en: You shall offer from the sacrifice of well-being, as an offering by fire to the Lord , the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is around the entrails;
text_cn: 由和平祭牺牲中，应取出献与上主作火祭的是：遮盖内脏的脂肪，和贴在内脏上所有的脂肪，

text_en: the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins, and the appendage of the liver, which he shall remove with the kidneys.
text_cn: 左右两肾和两肾靠腰部的脂肪，以及同两肾一起取出的肝叶。

text_en: Then Aaron’s sons shall turn these into smoke on the altar, with the burnt offering that is on the wood on the fire, as an offering by fire of pleasing odor to the Lord .
text_cn: 亚郎的儿子们应将这一切放在祭坛上的柴火上，同全燔祭牺牲一起焚烧，作为中悦上主的馨香火祭。

text_en: If your offering for a sacrifice of well-being to the Lord is from the flock, male or female, you shall offer one without blemish.
text_cn: 若有人给上主奉献一只羊作和平祭牺牲，应奉献一只无瑕的公羊或母羊。

text_en: If you present a sheep as your offering, you shall bring it before the Lord
text_cn: 如果奉献一只绵羊作牺牲，应将它牵到上主面前，

text_en: and lay your hand on the head of the offering. It shall be slaughtered before the tent of meeting, and Aaron’s sons shall dash its blood against all sides of the altar.
text_cn: 先按手在牺牲头上，后在会幕前宰了；亚郎的儿子将血洒在祭坛四周。

text_en: You shall present its fat from the sacrifice of well-being, as an offering by fire to the Lord : the whole broad tail, which shall be removed close to the backbone, the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat that is around the entrails;
text_cn: 那人由和平祭牺牲中应取出脂肪作献与上主的火祭：即靠脊骨割下的整个肥尾，遮盖内脏的脂肪，贴在内脏上所有的脂肪，

text_en: the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins, and the appendage of the liver, which you shall remove with the kidneys.
text_cn: 左右两肾和两肾上靠腰部的脂肪，以及同两肾一起取出的肝叶。

text_en: Then the priest shall turn these into smoke on the altar as a food offering by fire to the Lord .
text_cn: 司祭应将这一切放在祭坛上焚烧，有如食物，作为献与上主的火祭。

text_en: If your offering is a goat, you shall bring it before the Lord
text_cn: 如果奉献的祭品是一只山羊，应将它牵到上主前，

text_en: and lay your hand on its head; it shall be slaughtered before the tent of meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall dash its blood against all sides of the altar.
text_cn: 先按手在牺牲头上，后在会幕前宰了；亚郎的儿子们将血洒在祭坛四周。

text_en: You shall present as your offering from it, as an offering by fire to the Lord , the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat that is around the entrails;
text_cn: 那人由这牺牲中应取出献与上主作火祭的是：遮盖内脏的脂肪，贴在内脏上所有的脂肪，

text_en: the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins, and the appendage of the liver, which you shall remove with the kidneys.
text_cn: 左右两肾和两肾上靠腰部的脂肪，以及同两肾一起取出的肝叶。

text_en: Then the priest shall turn these into smoke on the altar as a food offering by fire for a pleasing odor. All fat is the Lord ’s.
text_cn: 司祭应将这一切放在祭坛上焚烧，有如食物，作为中悦上主的馨香火祭。

text_en: It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations, in all your settlements: you must not eat any fat or any blood.
text_cn: 一切脂肪应归于上主。凡是脂肪和血，你们都不可吃：这为你们世世代代，在你们任何所居之地，是一条永久的法令”。
